thread:
ana: Heads-up: seeing binding errors after runtime v4.0.0 rollout in eu-central with llama3q-quant. Errors start ~400 tokens and cause ACQUIRE failures. Rolling back fixed it. Requesting a region-scoped soft-pin to v3.9.7 while SDK team dives in.
mike: can you paste a short error sample and approx impact?
ana: sample: "ERR model_bind: kv_cache_mismatch -> acquire_failed". Impact: ~2.1% error rate in eu-central, zero in other regions. A few production customer requests retried, no major data loss.
kevin: Is this a runtime kernel change or SDK-side client handshake? Any link to failing test?
ana: quick repro: sdk-run --model llama3q-quant --seq 1200 --runtime 4.0.0 -> reproduce. SDK team found a regression in client runtime negotiation (PR 4901).
priya: Suggest soft-pin only at the routing layer for eu-central. Confirm this won't affect Dedicated racks.
mike: Dedicated unaffected. Routing only.
deploybot: new_pin_request PR-4321 created by ana. scope=region:eu-central, target_runtime=v3.9.7, type=soft, expires=2026-04-02T00:00:00Z, reason="model_bind/kv_cache mismatch after runtime v4.0.0 rollout". pending approvals: eng-oncall + release-leads.
ops-bot: runbook: https://runbook/redwood/pin -> steps: apply pin, warm cache, monitor model_bind metric for 30m, rollback plan included.
kevin: Proposed Canary: route 10% of new llama3q-quant requests to v3.9.7 for 45m, watch bind_error_rate and p99 latency. If bind_error_rate < 0.2% and p99 stable, expand to 100% in eu-central.
priya: Agreed. Also add synthetic probe hitting longseq paths.
mike: PR 4901 link?
ana: https://git.redwood/sdk/pull/4901 - negotiation fallback fix. CI green except flaky integration test sandbox/longseq-bind.
ops-bot: checklist: [x] pin request created PR-4321, [ ] approvals recorded, [ ] pin applied, [ ] canary monitoring started, [ ] rollback criteria defined.
mike: approve
kevin: approve
deploybot: approvals confirmed. Applying PR-4321 in 5m to reduce user impact.
priya: applied. Canary: 10% routing in eu-central now. Monitoring dashboards: https://telemetry/redwood/eu-central/bind-metrics.
nana: initial numbers: bind_error_rate -> 0.9% before pin, 0.1% after pin at 5m. p99 latency unchanged. Good sign.
kevin: keep watch for regressions when we later unpin. Recommend a staged unpin plan with 2-hour observation windows.
mike: noted. If bind_error_rate creeps >0.5% in the next 30m, we rollback.
ops-bot: reminder: update release notes and #customer-success if we extend beyond 24h.
priya: release note stub created: https://git.redwood/release-notes/3399 - "Temporary eu-central routing to runtime v3.9.7 due to model bind failures with runtime v4.0.0 on llama3q-quant. SDK PR 4901 in progress."
ana: thanks all, will follow up with postmortem ticket and test case id (longseq-bind-1200).
